hypothesis: Input-only disagreement between the two bases can identify groups where selecting the smaller same-sign prediction repairs more failures than it damages, including failures beyond the strict cap's range.
bins: Same-sign nonzero q with abs(q)<abs(b) only. log(abs(b))-log(abs(q)) bins with upper boundaries log(1.1),log(2),log(10),infinity. Boundaries included in upper bin via searchsorted side=right. Species-specific table,4binary entries each; no tuning.
fit: For each species/bin with at least128 training components, select q iff repairs>damage, damage/basepasses<=0.02 (empty basepass denominator is ineligible), and nontrivial pass count does not fall. Else retain b. Both bases/labels from same verified common50k, no U/D. No objective/threshold sweep.
inference: Choose q only when same-sign, strictly smaller nonzero magnitude and frozen table permits. Otherwise b. No references, temperature conditions, normalization, interpolation or endpoint clipping. Can repair larger errors but makes no sign-repair claim.
controls: Unchanged b and unconditionally selecting the eligible smaller q. Learn on25k and evaluate other25k; swap folds, both seeds. Report individual folds and pooled out-of-fold scores; pooled predictions are NOT one frozen deployable model.
decision: Proceed to a separately registered full50k table and isolated U/D only if every checkfold has positive net gain and damage<=0.02, and both pooled out-of-fold gains>=0.005 with all physical comparison gates passed. Otherwise close this coarse reliability-table recipe; no bin/cap sweep.
verification: Source report and every artifact hash; row identities/exposure inherited from reviewed common50k. Separate repair identity, masks/counts, protected scores. No reference generation. Subsets retain snapshots and species order.

resources.fits: Four finite count-table fits, no optimizer or GPU training
